# test_is_palindrome.py
import pytest

from your_module import is_palindrome  # Replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s", "expected"),
    [
        ("racecar", True),
        ("RaceCar", True),
        ("nurses run", True),
        ("No lemon no melon", True),
        ("hello", False),
        ("python", False),
        ("ab", False),
    ],
)
def test_is_palindrome_happy_path(s, expected):
    assert is_palindrome(s) is expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s", "expected"),
    [
        ("", True),
        (" ", True),
        ("      ", True),
        ("x", True),
        ("Aa", True),
        ("  A b a  ", True),
        ("a b c b a", True),
        ("a b c", False),
    ],
)
def test_is_palindrome_edge_cases(s, expected):
    assert is_palindrome(s) is expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s", "expected"),
    [
        ("Madam, I'm Adam", False),  # punctuation is not removed
        ("a!a", True),              # punctuation can be part of the palindrome
        ("a\tb a", False),          # tabs are not removed, only literal spaces
    ],
)
def test_is_palindrome_preserves_non_space_characters(s, expected):
    assert is_palindrome(s) is expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_value",
    [
        None,
        123,
        12.34,
        [],
        {},
        object(),
    ],
)
def test_is_palindrome_non_string_inputs_raise_attribute_error(bad_value):
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        is_palindrome(bad_value)


def test_is_palindrome_bytes_input_raises_type_error():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        is_palindrome(b"racecar")
